prompt: Create a professional character model-reference board for Cow 17 from an original mobile arcade game called Severe Weather Warning. Cow 17 is an upright bipedal black-and-white dairy cow mascot with chunky, appealing, readable proportions, expressive ears and eyes, sturdy hooves, a slightly deadpan blue-collar personality, and a recognizable takeaway cup for the fictional local sponsor Moo Brew. The visual language is storm-charged stylized Americana: warm small-town charm, slightly absurd humor, premium mobile-game finish. Avoid primitive cylinder limbs, toy-block anatomy, glossy plastic, photorealism, mascot-suit realism, and generic cartoon clip-art. Show a clean front view, 3/4 front view, side view, and back view with consistent proportions and markings, plus one small personality pose leaning casually as if at an office water cooler. Neutral light background, soft studio lighting, clear silhouette, PBR-friendly material cues, limited accessories, no environment clutter. Keep the same exact character identity in every view. The output is a 3D modeling reference, not a poster. If text is used, only the fictional words MOO BREW may appear on the cup.
